user.title: Import a Bluetooth Mesh network
user.description: Import a Bluetooth SIG Mesh network to expose its lamps in Home Assistant.

data_description.connect_json: Open your ThingOS / Häfele Connect Mesh .connect export file in a text editor and paste its entire contents here. It contains the network keys and node list.

reconfigure.title: Re-import the Bluetooth Mesh network
reconfigure.description: Paste a freshly exported .connect file to update this network — after adding a node, or refreshing a key. It must be the same network.

data_description.connect_json: Open your ThingOS / Häfele Connect Mesh .connect export file in a text editor and paste its entire contents here. It contains the network keys and node list.

error.invalid_connect: The pasted text is not a valid .connect network export: {error}. Paste the full contents of the exported file.
error.invalid_json: The pasted text is not valid JSON: {error}. Paste the full contents of the exported file; a partial or word-wrapped copy will not parse.

abort.already_configured: This mesh network is already configured.
abort.wrong_network: That export belongs to a different mesh network. Re-import the network this entry was created from, or add the other one as a separate entry.

init.title: Bluetooth Mesh options
init.description: A mesh lamp offers a single Bluetooth proxy connection slot. Keeping it open makes commands instant, but prevents the Häfele Connect Mesh app from connecting to the lamp while this integration is loaded.

data_description.keepalive_seconds: How long to hold the proxy connection after the last command. 0 = always connected (most responsive; the Häfele app cannot use the lamp). A positive value hands the lamp back to the app after that idle time, at the cost of a few seconds to reconnect on the next command.
data_description.src_addr: The address Home Assistant sends from. 0 derives it automatically, which is almost always right. Set it only if commands are ignored with no error: an export lists no provisioner, so if the vendor app claimed the same address, every message is discarded as a replay and nothing anywhere says so.

proxy_unreachable.title: No Bluetooth proxy for mesh network {network}

corrupt_connect_export.message: The stored .connect export could not be read ({error}). Reconfigure the entry with a fresh export.
